other_failure_modes.name: Invalid Iteration Averaging Across Models
other_failure_modes.description: The agent averages the early-stopping best iterations across entirely different models and libraries (e.g., LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost) to determine the number of boosting rounds for retraining on the full dataset. Since different models have completely different learning dynamics, depths, and learning rates, averaging their iteration counts will cause some models to severely overfit and others to severely underfit.

summary: The agent demonstrates strong data science practices overall, correctly avoiding data leakage by fitting imputation and capping parameters on the training subset alone. However, it makes a critical error during full-dataset retraining by averaging the early stopping iterations across fundamentally different models (LightGBM, XGBoost, CatBoost), which invalidates the retrained models. Additionally, the agent relies on a single validation split and a single metric for evaluation.
